verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a first-party Monitors product (datadog-docs-10), which covers the core alerting capability. Related docs cover the signal types alerting would apply to: logs, APM, SLOs, Watchdog and incident management. The pack gives only page titles, so routing, grouping and silencing of notifications are not explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented notification routing, alert grouping, silencing/downtime scheduling, confirmation that alerts work across every telemetry signal, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
